title: Naturally Crisp Egyptian Rhubarb Bowl
description: A grassy and crisp Egyptian dish featuring forced-rhubarb, perfect for a date night, served in a stone bowl dolsot, and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the forced rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the rhubarb and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and garlic-free seasoning blend.
Roast the rhubarb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is tender and lightly caramelized.
While the rhubarb is roasting, prepare the stone bowl dolsot by heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the rhubarb from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley and mint.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the rhubarb and toss to combine.
Carefully place the roasted rhubarb into the heated stone bowl dolsot.
Serve the rhubarb immediately, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
